title: Grateful Dead Live at Family Dog at the Great Highway on 1969-11-02
venue: Family Dog at the Great Highway
lineage: SBD > MR > C1 > DAT > Turtle Beach Fiji > SHN

ai_review.summary: Crystal‑clear soundboard capture of a high‑energy 1969 show highlighted by a legendary 30‑minute Dark Star, The Eleven and Death Don't Have No Mercy.
ai_review.review: The recording is an outstanding sound‑board source with crisp mids, booming bass and crystal‑clear drums that let every nuance shine. Musically the night is a showcase of late‑‘69 psychedelia – a soaring Dark Star that rolls into Feelin’ Groovy and Tighten‑Up jams, followed by a fiery St. Stephen → The Eleven → Death Don't Have No Mercy sequence that keeps the energy on full blast.

ai_rating.rationale: Over 70 reviews, the vast majority are 5‑star praises of both performance and sound quality; only a handful of low scores mention missing songs, not audio flaws.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewers repeatedly note crisp, clear mix with superb bass clarity and “crystal‑clear” drums; no significant drop‑outs or muffiness despite the SBE failure flag.

show_quality.setlist_flow: A seamless arc from the epic Dark Star into Feelin’ Groovy and Tighten‑Up jams, then a tight transition into St. Stephen → The Eleven → Death Don't Have No Mercy; the set feels like a single, flowing improvisational journey.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Praised for “perfect guitar tone,” soaring solos and even vocal moments on Death Don't Have No Mercy; his playing is described as deeply personal and intuitive.
band_member_comments.Phil: Bass highlighted as “popping away,” with excellent clarity – several reviewers call it the best‑ever bass sound on this era.
band_member_comments.Keys: Tom’s Hammond organ work (pre‑Brent) gets shout‑outs for adding swirling texture to the jams; overall keyboard ambience is noted as lush and inventive.
band_member_comments.Drums: Both Bill Kreutzmann and Mickey Hart receive accolades for “crystal‑clear” percussion that drives the high‑octane feel of The Eleven and other sections.
